title: IPv4: clarify Reserved flag wording per RFC 791
description:
### Summary

This patch updates the IPv4 Flags field display label and description for the reserved flag bit (`ip.flags.rb`).

### Details

RFC 791 section 3.1 defines the first bit in the IPv4 Flags field as "Reserved; must be zero." This change updates the label and description accordingly to reflect this requirement in Wireshark’s UI.

**Before:**

Reserved bit: not set

**After:**

Reserved flag (must be zero): not set

This improves clarity for standards compliance analysis without changing any behavior or field identifiers.

### Reference

- RFC 791, Section 3.1 — Internet Header Format

Hi!

This is my first contribution to Wireshark.

This merge request clarifies the IPv4 “Reserved” flag wording per **RFC 791 § 3.1**, changing the label and description to indicate it _must be zero_.

No behavior changes, only a small UI/label improvement for clarity and standards compliance.

The code builds successfully and the updated field displays correctly in Wireshark (Reserved flag (must be zero): not set).

Thank you for reviewing! I’ve rebased the branch on the latest master and confirmed it runs cleanly locally.
Hi Seth, can you valid your account ? for run CI ?

Hi Alexis! This is the first project I've worked on through GitLab, so I was a bit lost at this step. I think I finally managed to validate and run successfully! Let me know if I can do anything else!
Yes, it is good for CI ! thanks

Why not add an expert info if the value is not zero?

The text "(must be zero)" does not belong in the name. If added it should go in the blurb.

Hi Stig, thank you for the feedback.

I’ve updated the change to remove "(must be zero)" from the field name and moved that wording into the field’s blurb instead. I also added an expert info warning (ei_ip_reserved_bit_set) that is triggered when the reserved flag is non-zero, as you suggested.

This now matches the style used elsewhere in the IPv4 dissector (for example, similar handling of invalid or deprecated fields). The result is:

* Field name is just “Reserved bit”
* Tooltip / description clarifies that it must be zero (per RFC 791)
* If the bit is set, Wireshark now shows a Warning Expert Info entry

I have rebuilt and tested the updated changes using a packet with the reserved bit set to verify that the expert warning appears correctly.

Please let me know if you'd like the severity changed (e.g., from Warning to Note) or if you'd prefer a slightly different wording in the expert message.

Thanks again for the guidance!

commits_data.message:
IPv4: Add Expert Info when Reserved flag bit is set

Move '(must be zero)' from the field display name into the field blurb,
and add Expert Info (PI_WARN) when the IPv4 Reserved bit is non-zero,
per RFC 791. THis aligns with existing handling of anomalous IPv4 header
conditions."
